Jahmyr Gibbs and Ashton Jeanty give you perhaps the best young RB duo in the league, and Justin Herbert remains underrated in dynasty circles. Unfortunately the WR room is barren and your backup QBs read like waiver-wire fodder. With a league-high haul of first-round picks you’re clearly playing for 2026. Chudders Football Team.roast: Two firsts in two years and Gibbs. You’re that guy bench-pressing next to the trophy case.

Father Time.roast: Your WRs are wagyu beef; your RBs are ramen noodles.
